title: 平安集团Michael Guo：监管注资部分国有险企，行业韧性如何解读？
speaker: Michael Guo

segments.en: As far as the stimulus into the insurance industry, we do know, I think it was in September or a few months ago, we did get a bunch of stimulus, a capital injection into some of the state-owned insurance companies, not necessarily ping-on and mostly privately held.
segments.zh: 关于保险业的刺激措施，我们知道，大概在9月或几个月前，确实有一系列刺激政策，向一些国有保险公司注资，不一定是平安，而且大多是私营公司。

segments.en: But what does that say to you about the health of the insurance industry in China in a slowing economy, continually sluggish economy right now?
segments.zh: 但这说明了中国保险业在经济增长放缓、持续疲软的环境下的健康状况如何？

segments.en: Right. Well, you know, from our perspective, this is certainly a very positive action from the regulator, from the government's injecting capital.
segments.zh: 对，从我们的角度看，这当然是监管机构和政府注入资本的非常积极的举措。

segments.en: To make sure the overall industry is strong, is strong and state-resilient.
segments.zh: 以确保整个行业保持强劲，具有韧性和稳定性。

segments.en: For ping-on, we have very strong solving serious issues. Our capital position is actually quite good.
segments.zh: 对平安来说，我们很好地解决了一些重要问题。我们的资本状况实际上相当不错。

segments.en: Well, is that an indication? I mean, you were not part of that capital injection, obviously.
segments.zh: 那这是否是一个信号？我的意思是，显然你们没有参与那次注资。
